$comment: Deployment configuration. Copy to `testnet.json` and edit — `testnet.json` is gitignored because it carries region-specific commercial settings.
Amounts are in stroops (1 XLM = 10000000), written as strings so no precision is lost in the JSON.

This file is the single source of truth for both the on-chain configuration (deployed by `npm run deploy`) and the off-chain read model (seeded into Postgres by `backend/prisma/seed.ts`), so the two cannot describe different networks.
$complianceComment: Per-corridor tier bands, as the compliance hook enforces them.
`tier1_max`: at or below this, no attestation is needed.
`tier2_max`: above tier1 and at or below this, a STANDARD attestation is required.
Above tier2, an ENHANCED attestation is required.
These are the numbers the contract holds. The corridor block above mirrors them for the read model.
$escrowComment: Fee charged at settlement, in basis points. 200 = 2%.
$poolComment: Collateral ratio is the bond an agent must hold per unit of float drawn. 15000 = 150%.
